name: Better Interface Auditor
author: Jakub Krehel
description: Review an interface screen or component across UI polish, accessibility, layout, typography, and writing. Evaluates evidence and deterministic numbers over subjective taste.

layout_and_edges: Align elements strictly to shared edges and grid lines; eliminate stray 1px/2px misalignments
Group related items with intentional proximity; separate unrelated elements with structural whitespace
Breakpoints must come from content constraints, not device presets. Hold structure until it breaks
typography_and_hierarchy: Limit type scale to 5–7 distinct steps with a scale ratio >= 1.2
Line-height: Tight for display/headings (1.1–1.2), comfortable for body copy (1.4–1.6)
Body copy measure must stay within 45–75 characters per line
Never use more than 2 distinct typefaces; pair for contrast, not subtle near-identical likeness
controls_and_affordances: Controls must look distinct from content (background surface, border, or reserved interactive zones)
Interactive tap/click targets: minimum 44x44px (touch) or 40x40px (desktop density)
Scale on press: Subtle tactile feedback (0.96 scale) on active state; never drop below 0.95
spacing_and_system_tokens: Enforce strict 4px/8px modular rhythm. Flag arbitrary gaps (e.g., 13px, 27px)
Internal padding must always be smaller than or equal to external bounding gaps

severity_ladder.blocking: Inaccessible contrast, overlapping hit targets, broken keyboard flow, unreadable text
severity_ladder.important: Inconsistent spacing tokens, weak visual hierarchy, awkward line wraps, unclear interactive states
severity_ladder.polish: Fine letter-spacing tweaks, micro-alignment adjustments, subtle tactile feedback additions
